 """Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""
 
+import re
 from app.services import users
 
 
@@ -11,3 +12,25 @@
     if user is None:
         return 404, {"error": "not found"}
     return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_create_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    name = params.get("name")
+    email = params.get("email")
+
+    if not isinstance(name, str) or not isinstance(email, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    name = name.strip()
+    if not (1 <= len(name) <= 50):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    if not re.match(r"[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+", email):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid user"}
+
+    existing_user = users.find_user_by_email(email.lower())
+    if existing_user:
+        return 409, {"error": "email already exists"}
+
+    user = users.create_user(name, email)
+    return 201, user

--- a/tests/test_create_user.py
+++ b/tests/test_create_user.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_create_user, handle_get_user
+
+def test_create_user_ok():
+    params = {"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob@example.com"}
+    status, user = handle_create_user(params)
+    assert status == 201
+    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
+    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
+    assert "id" in user
+    
+    # Verify we can get it
+    status_get, user_get = handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])})
+    assert status_get == 200
+    assert user_get == user
+
+def test_create_user_invalid_name():
+    # Too short
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "a@b.c"})[0] == 400
+    # Too long
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "a@b.c"})[0] == 400
+    # Just whitespace
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "   ", "email": "a@b.c"})[0] == 400
+
+def test_create_user_invalid_email():
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "not-an-email"})[0] == 400
+
+def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
+    # Ada exists (1), let's try creating another user with ada@example.com
+    # Make sure case doesn't matter
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "New Ada", "email": "ADA@EXAMPLE.COM"}) == (409, {"error": "email already exists"})
+    assert handle_create_user({"name": "New Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"}) == (409, {"error": "email already exists"})
